title: Calibration back in time
body:
Hello,
It could be very useful to have the possibility to timestamp a calibration point so to set a calibration back in time...
I don't know if it is possible....

comments.body:
If the calibration is done by the transmitter (Firefly G6 for example), I don't see how that would be possible.
You haven't mentioned what CGM you use.
I can see the possibility if it is xDrip that is doing the calibration (associating raw values with blood glucose values).
Seems like a lot of work to address only a portion of the user community.

Would you please close this issue if you don't need it any more?
Otherwise, please add detail.
